entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to... I think I need to return something. A VeloBand tracker. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... VF7781-09B.

Thank you, Maria. I see your VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered on December 15th. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it's not broken. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My husband, he had to be rushed to the hospital. It was very sudden.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay.

He needed surgery, and on top of that, my son's military deployment got moved up unexpectedly. I haven't even had a moment to think, and the box is just sitting here. I don't understand all the policies. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Maria. I completely understand, and I'm very sorry for what your family is going through. Let me just check the policy for you right now... One moment.
Okay, I've pulled up your file and our return guidelines. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window.
Oh! Ninety days? The website said something else... I couldn't make sense of it.

No worries at all, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 22 days ago, we can absolutely process this for a full refund. I'll go ahead and email you a pre-paid shipping label right now.
Really? Oh, thank you so much. That's a huge relief. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Maria. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Charlie.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you and your family soon. Have a good day.
